server: Existing Vite 5174 serves dist-v2 build through its transform middleware; this is a local browser comparison, not a standalone production-server benchmark.

coldProtocol.method: Three unique directory aliases of the identical frozen dist-v2 build, same Chrome tab, viewport and time. No other tests/builds running. Target GLB resource transferSize verified as encodedBodySize+300 in every fresh-path sample.
coldProtocol.httpCache: Project assets use fresh URL paths; shared Vite runtime may remain cached.
coldProtocol.gpuDriverCache: Already warm and not reset; worst device-cold startup remains unverified.
coldProtocol.oldCachedSamples: Earlier setCacheDisabled navigation samples include transferSize=300 for cached resources; retained only as diagnostic, excluded from cold improvement claims.
coldProtocol.timingOrigin: Application main module bootStarted through first render return; excludes HTML/main-module download and parse before module execution. Not full navigation-to-visible time.

limitations: Forest GPU approximately 43 ms and frame interval approximately 51 ms: not smooth and not solved.
Early uncontrolled run had approximately 27.9 s first-frame tail. Final samples did not reproduce it; do not claim all GPU-cold tails eliminated.
Far slope large-scale repetition and straight parallel bank strips remain visually obvious.
Interior uses up to two static sky bounces and one sun bounce, not full GI.
No final light/color art pass this round; fine needle fuzziness and upper photo cards deferred.
